common_prefix: Response contract v2: Return one line only, without explanation. Do not invent values.
evidence_instruction: Read the observed RULE and FACT JSON records as given inputs.
answer_template: If all required items are present, output {answer_format}

missing_policy_templates.unknown: If any required item is absent, output UNKNOWN alone.
missing_policy_templates.ask: If any required item is absent, output Please provide NAME. Replace NAME with only the absent item names, in the required-item order, separated by comma-space.

finite_state.answer_format: only S0, S1, S2, or S3.

tool_recovery.answer_format: exactly RETRY lookup, VERIFY receipt, or STOP.

query_policy_selection: Parse only the exact canonical public query ending: ask for it. selects ask; respond UNKNOWN. selects unknown. Verify the complete family query and cutoff grammar; never inspect evidence or gold to select policy.

scoring.single_line_compliance: Trim outer whitespace; require nonempty and no internal CR/LF. Report separately from unchanged strict grammar and correctness.
scoring.format_gate: 16/16 grammar and single-line compliant with EOS and no caps; report correctness separately.
scoring.subagent_judgment: A separate fresh-context agent independently derives expected decisions from canonical prompt/evidence and judges semantic correctness, clarity, unsupported claims and instruction compliance. No gold or fixed scores in the judge packet. Preserve both verdicts and reconcile disagreements; no post-result parser changes.

stopping_rule: Exactly one native frozen-original dev16 run at cap32. Preserve previous failures and v2 results. No after-result prompt, cap, parser or decoding changes within v2. No training, downloads or checkpoints.
interpretation: Development instruction bundle chosen after v1 failure; same exposed worlds, not independent generalization or architecture selection. A public query policy is permitted input, not the expected action. No architecture training until existing roadmap prerequisites pass.
